name: qwen3.8-27b-nvfp4.rtx5090-256k-fp8kv-dflash2
notes: Qwen3.8-27B w4a4 (RadixArk/Qwen3.8-27B-NVFP4) on 1x RTX 5090 (sm_120 GB202, 32 GB). Copied verbatim from the 1x RTX PRO 6000 WS 256k profile (the cost-efficiency champion, 177-222 flat decode TPS at $1.23/hr) and adapted: gpu_memory_utilization 0.85 -> 0.90. VRAM estimate: ~11.4 GB weights + ~2.6 activation/graph/misc => ~14.7 GB KV pool at fp8_e4m3 (~16.4 KB/token incl. GDN state) ~= 900k tokens. Full 262144 context fits with ~3.4x headroom; expect decode ~290-320 TPS if the box is not power-capped (GB202 ~1792 GB/s vs PRO 6000 ~1344 GB/s). DFlash2 W4A16 drafter n=7; fp8 KV (NVFP4 KV is sm_100/103-only). Expected download 0.024 TB.
